title: ANGRAU scheduled AP EAPCET manual and spot counselling rounds for November 2026
description: Read the sourced ANGRAU November 2026 manual and spot counselling schedule for affiliated Andhra Pradesh agriculture colleges.
summary: ANGRAU published dated manual counselling slots (2–10 November 2026) and a spot counselling notice (11 November 2026) for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture admissions across constituent and affiliated colleges.

sections.heading: What the ANGRAU November 2026 counselling notice records
paragraphs: Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), Guntur recorded a phased manual counselling schedule on its 2026–27 undergraduate admission portal following Phase II college reporting on 23 October 2026. Special-category and AP AGRICET manual counselling was listed for 2 November 2026, followed by AP EAPCET rank-band manual counselling sessions on 3, 4, 6, 7, 9 and 10 November 2026, and spot counselling on 11 November 2026.
Each session applies only to registered candidates within the notified rank bands and subject to actual category-wise seat vacancies on the day of allotment.

sections.heading: How this affects ANGRAU-affiliated private agriculture colleges
paragraphs: Applicants considering [SBVR Agricultural College](/university/sbvr-agricultural-college), [N.S. Agricultural College](/university/n-s-agricultural-college), [Sri Krishnadevaraya College of Agricultural Sciences](/university/sri-krishnadevaraya-college-of-agricultural-sciences) and [Sri Kinjarapu Yerran Naidu College of Agricultural Sciences](/university/sri-kinjarapu-yerran-naidu-college-of-agricultural-sciences) should distinguish state convenor seats filled through ANGRAU manual/spot rounds from separate management-quota rules.

Read our [ANGRAU private agriculture college admission guide](/articles/angrau-private-agriculture-college-admission) and [counselling preparation checklist](/blogs/prepare-for-agriculture-counselling) before travelling for manual verification.

sections.heading: Documents and fee demand checks for manual counselling
paragraphs: Manual and spot counselling rounds typically require immediate production of original Class 10 and Intermediate marksheets, AP EAPCET rank card, residence/caste certificates, and readiness to pay the prescribed semester charge upon seat allotment. Confirm the exact fee category (convenor vs management) using [the agriculture fee budget guide](/articles/agriculture-fee-budget).

faqs.question: Does a manual counselling notice guarantee seat availability in every affiliated college?
faqs.answer: No. Manual and spot counselling depend on real-time vacancies remaining after earlier online phases. Check the live vacancy matrix published by ANGRAU.

faqs.question: Are convenor-quota and management-quota fees identical at ANGRAU-affiliated colleges?
faqs.answer: No. Convenor and management quotas have distinct fee structures approved under state and university norms. Confirm the exact quota on your allotment letter.
